reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and "Every batch lab-tested" on the box, which is the only proof-type thing in a sea of supplement marketing. One box for $29.99 is a cheap enough test to see if my leg cramps and sleep change, and I would pick the single-form one because three forms sounds like more marketing.
objection: Lab-testing tells me what is in the capsule, not that it will make me sleep better or stop cramps. I have been burned by supplements that did nothing, so I will not reorder unless I actually feel a difference.
